entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.comment: Applies to medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled people, prescribed by an act of general application on orthopaedic and other aids.

Applies to car seats for children. 
Reduced rate of 13% applies also on baby diapers.

entries.category_description: Pharmaceutical products of a kind normally used for health care, prevention of illness and as treatment for medical and veterinary purposes, including products used for contraception and sanitary protection
entries.comment:
Towels and tampons for feminine sanitary protection; menstrual cups
The reduced rate of 10% applies also to the following item: 3924 9000 90.

entries.category_description: Pharmaceutical products of a kind normally used for health care, prevention of illness and as treatment for medical and veterinary purposes, including products used for contraception and sanitary protection
entries.comment:
Supply of pharmaceutical products taxed at 0% (exempt with credit) from VAT.

Pharmaceutical products refers to the goods specified in the Customs Tariff contained in the First Schedule to the Import Duties Act classified under the CN codes listed.

The exemption does not apply to items falling under sub-headings 3001 and 3002 where these items are not used for therapeutic or prophylactic purposes
